subject: Vendor certification questions & PO integration timeline
messages:
From: OnboardOps <procurement@edgeworks.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@edgeworks.com
Date: 2026-11-02T15:20:00-08:00
Subject: Initial onboarding docs required for Redwood PO setup

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for the call earlier. To get EdgeWorks into Redwood's procurement system we need to confirm the exact insurance/endorsement requirements and the PO routing details. Can you confirm:  

- Specific limits required on the COI (GL / Umbrella / Products) and whether an Additional Insured endorsement is mandatory.
- Exact wording for the endorsement (if you require one).
- Where to upload the COI and W9 (do you have a vendor portal URL?).
- Remit address and PO contact for invoices (we typically need a PO # before billing).

We can provide a draft COI and W9 once we know the details. Also curious if Redwood will accept a conditional/temporary PO before endorsement is finalized — our accounts payable team prefers to start the PO in the system to avoid payment delays.

Attaching: EdgeWorks preliminary COI (draft) and W9 stub.

Attachments: EdgeWorks_Certificate_2026.pdf (attachment), EdgeWorks_W9.pdf (attachment)

Thanks,
Leah Park
OnboardOps — EdgeWorks Inc.
procurement@edgeworks.com

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: OnboardOps <procurement@edgeworks.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial onboarding docs required for Redwood PO setup

Leah — thanks for the note and for sending the drafts. Quick answers and next steps below:  

1) Minimum insurance limits we require for standard vendor onboarding:
   - Commercial General Liability: $1,000,000 per occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate
   - Umbrella/Excess Liability: $2,000,000
   - Products/Completed Ops (where applicable): $1,000,000
2) Additional Insured endorsement: preferred but not strictly blocking for non-production SaaS vendors. For vendors that handle customer data or integration work, we request an Additional Insured endorsement naming "Redwood Inference, Inc., its officers, directors and employees". If EdgeWorks has trouble obtaining that exact language, please flag and we can discuss exceptions.
3) Uploads: Please use our vendor portal (link below) to upload the final COI and W9. If you hit an upload limit, reply and we'll accept via secure file share.
   - Vendor portal: https://redwood.app/vendor-portal/EdgeWorks
4) PO / Remit: We can issue a conditional PO (PO-XXXX-YYYY) to start the billing process, but final invoice payment will be contingent on receiving the COI that meets the limits or an agreed-upon exception. Remit address for invoices: accounts-payable@redwood.com; Redwood Inference, Inc., 310 Redwood Ave, San Francisco, CA 94107.

Grace, tagging you for comment re: endorsement wording and subcontractor disclosure.

Next steps for EdgeWorks: upload final COI + W9 to the portal and confirm whether any subcontractors will be used so Grace can advise on subcontractor language. Once docs validate, procurement will issue the PO and let AP know the invoice flow.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, OnboardOps <procurement@edgeworks.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial onboarding docs required for Redwood PO setup

Hi Leah — a couple of legal items to confirm:  

- Endorsement language: we typically accept an Additional Insured endorsement using the following phrase: "Redwood Inference, Inc., its officers, directors, employees, and agents". If your broker cannot provide that, provide the closest available endorsement text and we'll review. (I've attached a sample endorsement snippet for broker use.)
- Subcontractors: please confirm whether EdgeWorks engages subcontractors for any work under the agreement. If yes, we require that subcontractors are covered under the vendor's policy or that the vendor flow-downs equivalent requirements to subcontractors.
- Cyber / Data: if EdgeWorks will store or process Redwood customer data, we will need confirmation of appropriate cyber coverage or alternative controls; flag here if applicable.

I attached "sample-endorsement-text.txt" which you can send to your broker. If anything deviates from the sample, send the broker response and we can evaluate.

Grace O'Connor
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference

From: OnboardOps <procurement@edgeworks.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-10T09:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial onboarding docs required for Redwood PO setup

Thanks Dylan / Grace — appreciate the clear checklist. Quick status update:  

- We'll upload the finalized COI and W9 to the vendor portal by end of day tomorrow. Broker advised they can include the Additional Insured language you provided; they will generate the endorsement and send a certified COI.
- EdgeWorks does use one subcontractor for on-site hardware testing; subcontractor is covered under EdgeWorks' policy and we will include the subcontractor declaration form in the upload.
- Regarding the conditional PO: AP requests that Redwood issue a PO so they can schedule the first milestone invoice. Can you confirm the PO number and whether Redwood will allow the first invoice to be submitted pending receipt of the final endorsement? If not, we'll coordinate milestone timing to match the COI delivery.

We'll reply once uploads are complete. Thanks again for the quick turnaround.

Leah Park
OnboardOps — EdgeWorks Inc.
procurement@edgeworks.com
